client_brief:
Six painted crest lockups prepared for an apparel capsule

Evergreen Provisions needs the six painted crest lockups prepared for its small garment capsule. The brush character matters, but the artwork must hold at the actual garment width rather than only in a large presentation.

Please prepare
- Apparel crest production artwork: 6 named exports. The crest matches the authoritative painted reference. The brush character survives the reduction to each export's print width in evergreen_plate_schedule.csv (print_width_in), and each file is set to that width.
- Garment capsule application presentation: 1 named export. The graphic placement follows the garment schedule, and each application states its schedule placement and print width. The presentation distinguishes print artwork from illustrative mockup; where no photograph of the printed side was supplied, the application is shown on a drawing labelled as illustrative mockup. Painted crest lettering is never retyped inside a crest; outside the crests, design names may be set as capsule titles and in spec copy.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: A vertically integrated cannabis retailer running two dispensary storefronts, launching a short-run counter-sold apparel capsule.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2019, Bend, Oregon. Two owned dispensary shops, owner-run, with a small counter-retail apparel line.
brand_identity.about: Evergreen Provisions runs two dispensary shops in Bend, built around six house strain families. Two years ago the owners paid a local sign painter to hand-paint a crest panel for each family onto the shop walls. Customers photograph them constantly and ask where they can buy them, and the first apparel capsule exists to answer that question without losing the hand that made the panels.
brand_identity.audience: Craft-minded dispensary customers aged 25 to 45 who buy at the counter on the strength of the wall panels they already photograph. People who pay for the painted origin, not for a logo.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Tees at 32 dollars, hoodies at 70 dollars, short-run and counter-sold. Elevated streetwear priced above gas-station merch and below a designer drop. The painted texture is the product, so the value sits in the brush surviving, not in gloss or foil.

brand_identity.typography: Evergreen Provisions runs two families, and its first two steps are one lockup rather than two independent sizes. Step 01 is the plate number in Knockout HTF31 Junior Middleweight at 40 pt on 42 pt with tracking at 0 units, because a bare figure is never letterspaced. Step 02 is the capsule title in the same face, caps at 20 pt on 22 pt tracked 30 units, flush to the same left edge as the number directly above it, so every spread opens with a large figure sitting over a small tight title; on screen that title sets at 28 px on 31 px. Step 03 is ink tables and spec copy in Founders Grotesk Regular at 9 pt on 12.5 pt, tracking 0 units, always tabular lining figures, measure held to a maximum of 65 characters. Step 04 is captions in Founders Grotesk Medium at 7.5 pt on 10 pt with tracking at +15 units. A painted crest word is never set in Knockout or in any other font.
brand_identity.voice: Warm, plain-spoken, shop-floor honest. No luxury posturing and no carnival hype. Example line: "These are hand painted panels and that is the entire reason anyone wants them. Keep the brush in it, and tell us plainly what came back and what did not."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The six crest panels were hand-painted by a local sign painter who has since moved to Montana and left no sketches or files. The only surviving artwork is a set of bench photographs of the finished panels, shot over two visits under mixed light. There is no vector art and no separation art, which is exactly why the screen printer cannot quote a run.
brand_identity.values: Craft and honesty. Keep the painted hand, hold the palette to the inks the decorator already stocks, and say plainly what the paintings can and cannot give a screen.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every capsule title is Knockout HTF31 Junior Middleweight caps at 20 pt carrying its plate number directly above in the same face at 40 pt on the same left edge, so each spread opens with a large figure sitting over a small tight title.

scale.note: The plate number, and the thing the eye lands on first. It sits directly above the capsule title on the same left edge, so every spread opens with a large figure over a tight line. Size already stated in the existing prose; only the leading and the 0 tracking are added, because a bare figure is never letterspaced.
The capsule title. Caps at 20 pt tracked 30 units, both already stated in the existing prose, flush to the same left edge as the plate number above it. On screen the title sets at 28 px on 31 px.

scale.sample: Six house strain families, each painted on a shop wall.
scale.note: Ink tables and spec copy, always tabular lining figures so ink counts and run quantities stack in column. Both numbers already stated in the existing prose.
Captions. 7.5 pt comes from the existing prose; leading and the slight positive tracking are added so a caption under a bench photograph stays readable on Bone Primer.

type_system.signature_move: Every capsule title is Knockout HTF31 Junior Middleweight caps at 20 pt tracked 30 units carrying its plate number directly above in the same face at 40 pt on the same left edge, so each spread opens with a large figure sitting over a small tight title. Steps 01 and 02 are that lockup, read top to bottom.
rules: Never set a painted crest word in Knockout or any other font. The crests are painted artwork and stay painted.
The plate number and the capsule title are one lockup: number at 40 pt directly above title at 20 pt, both flush to the same left edge.
Capsule titles are always caps tracked 30 units. The plate figure is never tracked.
Ink tables and spec copy always use tabular lining figures so ink counts and run quantities align.
Screen titles set at 28 px. No other screen title size exists.
Hold the palette to the inks the decorator already stocks, so type prints in the same pass as the panel art.
No luxury posturing and no carnival hype in the copy that fills the scale. Warm, plain, shop floor honest.

palette_rules.distribution: Crest artwork has no ground: its background stays transparent, and every ink is a shelf ink from evergreen_ink_book.txt, at its palette hex where it has one; Harvest Gold, the ink book's warm ochre, has no palette hex and is used only in crest artwork and ink swatches. In the presentation, grounds and panels are Bone Primer only, as on evergreen_spec_card_2024.pdf. On Bone Primer, plate numbers, spec copy and body text are Bench Black, as the card's wordmark and spec lines; capsule titles, labels, captions and rules are Bench Black or Cedar Bark, as the card's subtitle, labels, rules and footer. Sage Field, Aubergine Deep and Harvest Gold appear in the presentation only inside crest artwork or as ink swatches, never as a ground, panel, rule or type, and the swatches together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, in the crest artwork and in the presentation. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, filter or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and dry-brush breakup is drawn as open gaps in solid shapes, never as transparency. No scrim, gradient or tinted overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph; a crest placed on a garment photograph in a mockup sits solid, at full opacity, with no blend mode.
palette_rules.forbidden: No neon, fluorescent, foil, gloss or metallic effect on any ink, type, panel, rule or icon, as evergreen_ink_book.txt and the brand's price positioning rule out. No colour outside the five palette hexes (#3B2B3A, #6B4A2E, #7C8A5F, #E7E0D0 and #1A1714) for type, grounds, panels, rules or icons, so the white proof mount of evergreen_spec_card_2024.pdf is not carried forward. No ink off evergreen_ink_book.txt in crest artwork.
palette_rules.photography: Garment and panel photographs keep their own true colour once corrected and are never recoloured toward the palette.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Recover only features supported by the references; do not describe an automatic trace as engraving, cutting, embroidery, or press ready without inspectable path evidence.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
